seed-001.text_en: Came for lunch and waited almost 40 minutes for a plate of chicken rice. Food was fine but the wait is ridiculous for a hawker stall.
seed-001.text_original: Came for lunch and waited almost 40 minutes for a plate of chicken rice. Food was fine but the wait is ridiculous for a hawker stall.
seed-001.actionable_quote: Waited almost 40 minutes for a plate of chicken rice at lunch.

seed-002.text_en: Queued for over half an hour to get the food; clearly understaffed at midday. The taste is okay, but the wait was too long.
seed-002.text_original: 排队等了半个多小时才拿到食物，中午人手明显不够。味道还可以，但等太久了。
seed-002.actionable_quote: Queued over half an hour for food; understaffed at midday.

seed-003.text_en: The sambal here is incredible, best I have had in the east. Auntie was so warm and even remembered my order from last time.
seed-003.text_original: The sambal here is incredible, best I have had in the east. Auntie was so warm and even remembered my order from last time.
seed-003.actionable_quote: The sambal is incredible and the auntie remembered my order.

seed-004.text_en: The table wasn't wiped, sticky with oil. The floor was dirty too. The food is tasty but hygiene needs attention.
seed-004.text_original: Meja tak dilap, lengket dengan minyak. Lantai pun kotor. Makanan sedap tapi kebersihan kena jaga.
seed-004.actionable_quote: Table not wiped and sticky with oil; floor dirty.

seed-005.text_en: 45 minutes for two plates of noodles at lunchtime. The queue was out the door and only one person was cooking. Never again on a weekday.
seed-005.text_original: 45 minutes for two plates of noodles at lunchtime. The queue was out the door and only one person was cooking. Never again on a weekday.
seed-005.actionable_quote: 45 minutes for two plates of noodles at lunch, only one person cooking.

seed-006.text_en: Had to wait forty minutes for lunch. The food was good, but the wait time is far too long.
seed-006.text_original: மதிய உணவுக்கு நாற்பது நிமிடம் காத்திருக்க வேண்டியிருந்தது. உணவு நன்றாக இருந்தது, ஆனால் காத்திருப்பு நேரம் மிக அதிகம்.
seed-006.actionable_quote: Had to wait forty minutes for lunch.

seed-007.text_en: Came on a weekend at midday, waited nearly 40 minutes. Only one person cooking in the kitchen and the queue was long. The food is fine, it's just too slow.
seed-007.text_original: 周末中午来，等了差不多40分钟。厨房只有一个人在炒，队伍很长。食物没问题，就是太慢。
seed-007.actionable_quote: Weekend midday wait nearly 40 minutes, only one cook.

seed-008.text_en: Uncle at the stall is a legend, always cheerful even during the rush. Portions are generous and the price has not gone up in years.
seed-008.text_original: Uncle at the stall is a legend, always cheerful even during the rush. Portions are generous and the price has not gone up in years.
seed-008.actionable_quote: Uncle is always cheerful during the rush; portions generous, price stable.

seed-009.text_en: Prices went up again, now eight ringgit for a regular chicken rice. Taste is just okay, not worth the price.
seed-009.text_original: Harga naik lagi, sekarang lapan ringgit untuk nasi ayam biasa. Rasa okay je, tak sepadan dengan harga.
seed-009.actionable_quote: Now eight ringgit for regular chicken rice, not worth it.

seed-010.text_en: Lunch service is broken. Ordered at 12:15, got my food at 1:05. Almost an hour. The staff know it is bad, they keep apologising but nothing changes.
seed-010.text_original: Lunch service is broken. Ordered at 12:15, got my food at 1:05. Almost an hour. The staff know it is bad, they keep apologising but nothing changes.
seed-010.actionable_quote: Ordered at 12:15, got food at 1:05 - almost an hour.

seed-011.text_en: Arrived at 12:30, didn't get a seat and food until 1:15. Too few staff, one person simply can't keep up. Won't dare come at lunch again.
seed-011.text_original: 中午12点半来，等到1点15分才有位子和食物。人手太少，一个人根本忙不过来。以后不敢午餐时间来了。
seed-011.actionable_quote: Arrived 12:30, no seat or food until 1:15; too few staff.

seed-012.text_en: Came at 1pm, the food took fifty minutes to arrive. Not enough staff. The food wasn't hot, because of waiting so long.
seed-012.text_original: மதியம் ஒரு மணிக்கு வந்தேன், உணவு வர ஐம்பது நிமிடம் ஆனது. வேலையாட்கள் போதவில்லை. உணவு சூடாக இல்லை, அவ்வளவு நேரம் காத்ததால்.
seed-012.actionable_quote: Came at 1pm, food took fifty minutes and arrived not hot.

seed-013.text_en: Saturday lunch, waited 55 minutes. This is the third weekend in a row it has been like this. Whatever changed a month ago, please change it back.
seed-013.text_original: Saturday lunch, waited 55 minutes. This is the third weekend in a row it has been like this. Whatever changed a month ago, please change it back.
seed-013.actionable_quote: Saturday lunch, waited 55 minutes - third weekend in a row.

seed-014.text_en: Midday is very slow. Waited almost an hour for mee goreng. Only one person cooking during the lunch rush, really can't cope.
seed-014.text_original: Tengah hari sangat lambat. Menunggu hampir sejam untuk mee goreng. Satu orang je masak masa lunch rush, memang tak larat.
seed-014.actionable_quote: Waited almost an hour for mee goreng; one cook during lunch rush.

seed-015.text_en: Dinner on a weeknight was a totally different experience, quick and quiet. The hor fun had great wok hei. Come after 7pm and you are fine.
seed-015.text_original: Dinner on a weeknight was a totally different experience, quick and quiet. The hor fun had great wok hei. Come after 7pm and you are fine.
seed-015.actionable_quote: Dinner on a weeknight was quick and quiet; come after 7pm.

seed-016.text_en: The auntie is very nice, top-notch service attitude. Coming in the evening is comfortable, hardly any queue. The food taste has always been consistent.
seed-016.text_original: 阿姨人很好，服务态度一流。晚上来吃很舒服，没什么人排队。菜的味道一直都很稳定。
seed-016.actionable_quote: Auntie is very nice; evenings comfortable with hardly any queue.

seed-017.text_en: The curry was lukewarm when it reached me, like it had been sitting out. Taste was there but I had to ask them to heat it up again.
seed-017.text_original: The curry was lukewarm when it reached me, like it had been sitting out. Taste was there but I had to ask them to heat it up again.
seed-017.actionable_quote: The curry was lukewarm, like it had been sitting out.

seed-018.text_en: Tray return area was overflowing and nobody cleared it for the whole time I was there. Tables sticky. The food deserves a cleaner setting.
seed-018.text_original: Tray return area was overflowing and nobody cleared it for the whole time I was there. Tables sticky. The food deserves a cleaner setting.
seed-018.actionable_quote: Tray return area overflowing the whole time; tables sticky.

seed-019.text_en: I asked for chicken biryani, they gave me mutton biryani. They refused to take it back. Carelessness.
seed-019.text_original: நான் கோழி பிரியாணி கேட்டேன், அவர்கள் ஆட்டு பிரியாணி கொடுத்தார்கள். திரும்பக் கொடுக்க மறுத்தார்கள். கவனக்குறைவு.
seed-019.actionable_quote: Asked for chicken biryani, got mutton, and they refused to swap it.

seed-020.text_en: Very noisy at lunch, hard to hear people talk. The fan is broken too, hot. The food is still tasty as usual.
seed-020.text_original: Bising sangat masa lunch, susah nak dengar orang bercakap. Kipas pun rosak, panas. Makanan tetap sedap macam biasa.
seed-020.actionable_quote: Very noisy at lunch and the fan is broken, so it's hot.

seed-021.text_en: Still the best value lunch in the neighbourhood if you come early. Was seated and eating within ten minutes at 11:15am.
seed-021.text_original: Still the best value lunch in the neighbourhood if you come early. Was seated and eating within ten minutes at 11:15am.
seed-021.actionable_quote: Best value lunch if you come early - seated and eating within ten minutes at 11:15am.

seed-022.text_en: The portion is much smaller than before, but the price is the same. One small piece of chicken with a pile of rice, not enough to fill you up.
seed-022.text_original: 份量比以前少了很多，价钱却一样。一小块鸡肉配一堆饭，吃不饱。
seed-022.actionable_quote: Portion much smaller than before for the same price; one small piece of chicken.
